description_en: Modifies the security audit settings of an interactive messaging application
description_zh: 修改互动消息应用安全审核设置
name: ModifyLiveMessageAppAudit

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改信息的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The security audit method. Valid values:
0: No security audit.
1: Built-in security audit.
2: Custom security audit
parameters.help_zh:
安全审核方式。取值：
0：不进行安全审核
1：内置安全审核
2：自定义安全审核
parameters.name: audit_type

parameters.help_en: The security audit URL required when custom security audit is used (AuditType=2). The URL must start with http:// or https://, must not contain private IP addresses, and must not include port numbers
parameters.help_zh: 如果是自定义安全审核（AuditType=2），则需要提供安全审核的地址。安全审核地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号
parameters.name: audit_url

parameters.help_en: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AppId.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application to modify
AppId.description_zh: 需要修改的互动消息应用ID

AppSign.description_en: The signature of the interactive messaging application. This information is required by the interactive messaging service SDK
AppSign.description_zh: 互动消息应用签名，互动消息服务SDK需要该信息

AuditNeedAuthentication.description_en: Indicates whether call authentication is enabled. If custom security audit is used, this parameter is set to true by default to enable call authentication
AuditNeedAuthentication.description_zh: 调用鉴权。如果是自定义安全审核，则默认为true开启调用鉴权

AuditUrl.description_en: The security audit URL provided when AuditType is set to 2
AuditUrl.description_zh: AuditType为2时提供的安全审核地址
